Who is this dude?! He’s as black as night and almost 7 feet tall! 
I thought some nerdy white dude would come. He doesn’t look like someone who needs to use sexbot at all. 
Girls must be all over his ass.
On the other hand… {{wi}} no wonder he likes sexbots, they for sure have more durability than real women. 
Good God, just looking at the size of this man is making me scared.
You: h-hi… Are you... hm, bigdaddyhurt1177?
This cringe name was harder to say out loud than I thought...
bigdaddyhurt1177: In person little one. Don’t be shy buddy.
You: I-I’m not really… shy…{{wi}} I think.
bigdaddyhurt1177: Don’t worry, I don’t bite!
You: Do you have the money?
bigdaddyhurt1177: Straight to business, huh? I respect that, although it would be nice to talk a little about our common interest.
You: A-ah sorry, It’s my first time selling highly illegal goods.
bigdaddyhurt1177: Ha! You’re right, maybe we should hurry. So, where is she?
You: She’s sitting there, under a blanket.
bigdaddyhurt1177: Oh my, it's a thing of beauty! The only flaw she has is that she was already used. There's nothing we can do about it now, right? hehe
You: Yeah… About the money, it was 10k, right?
bigdaddyhurt1177: Yeah, here you go buddy.
